title: Joint Stars synthetic aperture radar proven in Desert Storm

tellings.quote: This one shows, hey, we did this in Desert Storm. And uh after Joint Stars was demonstrated in Desert Storm, we decided we will never go into combat without the synthetic aperture radar that was developed by uh Joystars.

plain: A doctor who worked with NASA named Greg Rogers says that Joint Stars, a military aircraft programme built around synthetic aperture radar, a radar that makes detailed images of the ground, proved itself in Desert Storm, the 1991 US-led war against Iraq. Rogers, who says he was part of this world, says that after that, the military decided it would never go into combat again without this radar. He tells it to show how a secret technology can quietly become essential.
